author: Nazz22fvuuvvufuudf

title: Simple to use app
body:
It does what you expect. Track habits easily, focus and journal. I use the two first mentioned features and to have one app for these two activities was surprisingly useful.

Now to feedback:
- For someone no never journals on their phone. I would like the opportunity to completely remove this feature from the home row.

- We need an AW app now.

- During focus mode, doesn't Apple have the new live activity feature so we can see the remaining time on the lockscreen.

- I want to be able to change colour on specific habits.
